📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text into the box.
  2. Character stats update live as you type.
  3. Watch the X/Twitter gauge to stay within 280 characters.
  4. Check the SMS line to see how many message segments you need.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the X/Twitter limit?

A standard post on X/Twitter allows up to 280 characters. The gauge shows how many you have left and warns you when you go over.

How are SMS segments calculated?

A single SMS holds 160 standard characters (70 if you use emoji or non-Latin script). Longer messages are split into 153- or 67-character segments.

Does the tool work offline?

Yes. Once the page loads, all counting runs locally in your browser.
